topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I didn't expect to find my old teddy bear at a yard sale, not after all these years. The familiar patch where his ear is frayed, the button nose that somehow stayed intact—I recognized him instantly. It’s strange, the way objects can hold memories, how they can bring you right back. I ran my fingers over his soft fur, and it felt like coming home. Without hesitation, I bought him. Holding him now, I’m reminded of simpler times, of the warmth and safety of my childhood. It’s a good find, a piece of my past, back in my arms.
